newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Tunisia gets ATFP $17 million line of credit.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia gets ATFP $17 million line of credit.

text.p: The Arab Trade Financing Programme (ATFP) on Saturday approved a $17 million line of credit for Tunisia.
ATFP said in a statement Tunisia would use the credit line to refinance two commercial deals with other Arab states.

ATFP was set up in 1991 to develop and promote trade among Arab states and to make their products more competitive. It is 50 percent owned by the Abu Dhabi-based Arab Monetary Fund -- the Arab world's main financial institution.
